source: Latvian Office of Citizenship and Migration Affairs (PMLP), Physical Persons Register names, 1 July 2026
selection: Up to 1,000 complete given-name strings or combinations per explicitly recorded sex, descending count then UTF-8 spelling. Retain counts of at least five. Exclude unspecified sex, empty values, placeholders and strings outside the documented letter/separator filter. Includes foreign names as registered; these are register observations, not birth rankings.
display: Trim outer whitespace and normalize NFC. Convert uppercase words to initial capitals, preserving diacritics, separators and whole name combinations. Do not split compound given names.
nameFilter: At least two characters, starts with a Unicode letter, ends with a Unicode letter or mark; only letters, combining marks, spaces, apostrophes (straight or U+2019) and hyphens. Whitespace-trimmed NFC spellings are aggregated if identical.
licenseScope: The official government catalogue identifies this exact dataset and its publishing government authority and explicitly declares CC0-1.0. Applies to the downloadable CSV/XML dataset; only aggregate name or surname selections are redistributed.
attribution: Latvian Office of Citizenship and Migration Affairs (PMLP), Physical Persons Register names, 1 July 2026. Independently selected and processed by this library.
